title: Module sheafification from affine-open restriction
statement: Let Y be a scheme. Let C be a category and let P : C → PresheafOfModules(O_Y) and Q : C → SheafOfModules(O_Y) be functors. If the restrictions of P and the underlying presheaf of Q to the affine-open basis of Y are naturally isomorphic, then the sheafification of P is naturally isomorphic to Q.

source.place: Tags 009U (lemma-restrict-basis-equivalence-modules) and 0089: module restriction to a basis and module sheafification

proof.text: Affine opens form a basis (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens), hence the inclusion is cover dense by TopCat.Opens.coverDense_iff_isBasis. Apply Functor.IsCoverDense.restrictHomEquivHom to underlying presheaves. The extended map is linear by restricting scalar-linearity along the cover-dense sieve and using separatedness of the target sheaf.

For each parameter, extend the affine restriction isomorphism to a module-presheaf map, factor uniquely through module sheafification by its adjunction, and prove parameter naturality by injectivity of restriction and naturality of the given isomorphism.

For every module sheaf N, precomposition with the extended map is bijective on maps into N, by the same affine restriction equivalence and the basis isomorphism. Transfer this bijection through the sheafification adjunction and apply the co-Yoneda isomorphism criterion.
